import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    f = params[0] + params[1]/t + params[2]*t + params[3]*np.log(t) + params[4]/t**2 + params[5]*np.exp(-t) + params[6]*np.sin(t) + params[7]*np.cos(t)
    h = -params[8]*t**params[9]/(t**params[9] + 6.0)
    return f + h*A**2
